items.title: EOG Resources (EOG) Raised Its Regular Dividend By 8%
items.summary: EOG Resources (NYSE:EOG) reported record Q3 2026 production and strong earnings on 5 November 2026. The board approved an 8% increase to the regular dividend, adding more cash returns for shareholders. Management announced a new long term gas sales agreement alongside expansion plans for the Janus facility. Record output, a higher dividend and the Janus expansion only tell part of today's story for EOG. Our analysis turns up 3 warning signs (1 major) for EOG Resources as well. For readers...
